prefixItems.description: Pairs have unique names in strictly increasing UTF-16 order and include $actql_value. Values are recursively projected; pair arrays are structural, not projected business arrays.

effect_preview.title: actql-effect-preview-0.1
effect_preview.$comment: Semantic CID omits effect_preview_cid, run_identity_cid, authoring_context, and nested changes[].row_idempotency_key only. Each effect_member_preview_cid is the CID of {version:actql-effect-member-preview/0.1,member:MemberSemanticBody}, where MemberSemanticBody omits that self CID and nested row_idempotency_key only. Excluded transport fields still require exact apply binding.
